properties.name: Delinea - Failed authentication spike (single account)
properties.description:
Detects when a single account accumulates an unusually high number of failed authentication
events within a short window. Only authentication events - MFA, login and sign-in - are
considered; the service-wide view of every failure lives in the 'Delinea - Failed operations'
hunting query. A failure is a failed MFA result, a failed password factor, or any login fail
reason. A burst of failures for one account can indicate brute-force or credential-stuffing
activity. Tune 'threshold' to your environment.
